ideas.title: The Impact of Child Care Fraud on Minnesota Families
ideas.description: This story could investigate the impact of child care fraud on families in Minnesota and the efforts being made to prevent it.
ideas.angle: The human impact of child care fraud
questions: How many families are affected by child care fraud in Minnesota?
What are the consequences for families who lose child care services due to fraud?
searches: impact of child care fraud on families
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the personal impact of child care fraud and the need for greater accountability in the administration of child care funds.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Source of Minnesota's Fraud Problem
ideas.description: This story could investigate the source of Minnesota's fraud problem and the efforts being made to prevent it.
ideas.angle: The root causes of fraud in Minnesota
questions: What are the most common types of fraud in Minnesota?
What are the underlying causes of fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story could provide a deeper understanding of the root causes of fraud in Minnesota and the steps being taken to prevent it.
